errors.timing: daemon lease: deadline {deadline} plus heartbeat {heartbeat} must be shorter than the idle timeout {idle}
errors.configure: daemon lease: set the session idle timeout

log.waiting: another daemon holds this database's lease; waiting ({waited} so far)
log.acquired_after_wait: took the daemon lease after waiting {waited}
log.lost: lost the daemon lease: no confirmation for {since} ({err}); stopping so another daemon can take over
log.drop_conn: daemon lease: drop the lock connection
log.close_conn: daemon lease: close the lock connection
log.unconfirmed: the database has not confirmed the daemon lease for {since} ({err}); this is the only daemon, so it keeps running and checks again with backoff
log.confirmed_again: the database confirms the daemon lease again after {since}
log.reclaimed: the daemon lease's session ended after {since} without confirmation and nobody else held the lock; took it back on a new session
log.taken: lost the daemon lease: no confirmation for {since} and another daemon now holds the lock; stopping
